kicker: Atria Dawn, by Shanghai AI Lab

scenes.headline: How Atria Dawn is built, and what its scores count
scenes.sub: A GLM-5.2 fine-tune, checked from its own files.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Daybreak! Atria Dawn is a new agent model from Shanghai. Let's open its files and see what is inside.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Atria keeps GLM-5.2's architecture exactly and changes only the weights, by training on agent work that was checked.
scenes.say: The new part is not the network. Atria keeps the GLM five point two architecture tensor for tensor, and post-trains it on agent work with verified outcomes.

steps.say: Each token meets a router, which scores two hundred fifty six experts.
It keeps the best eight. The other experts sit idle for this token.
One shared expert always runs, and the outputs are added together.
Seventy five layers work this way, so a token touches about forty billion of over seven hundred billion parameters.

steps.label: Full attention
steps.say: Plain attention reads every earlier token, so cost grows with the context.

steps.label: Indexer keeps 2,048
steps.note: the main attention reads only these
steps.say: A small indexer scores the cache and keeps the top two thousand and forty eight entries per query.

steps.label: 21 of 78 layers index
steps.say: Only twenty one layers run the indexer. The others reuse its choice, which keeps long context cheap.

scenes.label: of 753.3B stored, counted from 353 file headers
scenes.say: Counting every tensor shape gives forty point three billion active parameters per token.

left.title: Medal rate
items: Needs a place near the top
left.say: Machine learning benchmarks usually count medals, which need a place near the top of a Kaggle leaderboard.

right.title: HumanRank
right.say: Atria reports HumanRank instead, the share of human entrants beaten. That is why its score looks so high.

scenes.title: AutomationBench, same model
scenes.note: who ran it moves the score
scenes.say: And on AutomationBench, the same model scores very differently depending on who ran it. Compare inside one table only.

scenes.text: Atria is GLM-5.2 with new weights. Read every launch number with the metric it counts.
scenes.say: So Atria is GLM five point two with new weights. Read each launch number together with the metric behind it.

recap: HumanRank is not a medal rate
scenes.say: The same skeleton, eight experts per token, and a score that counts beaten humans, not medals.
